statement: US index futures earn higher RTH returns on the last trading day and first 3 trading days of the month.
mechanism: Month-end pension/payroll flows and portfolio rebalancing (Lakonishok & Smidt 1988; Ariel 1987; McConnell & Xu 2008).
falsification: TOM RTH long not better than non-TOM RTH long (baseline) or TRAIN Sharpe < 0.5.

sources.title: McConnell & Xu (2008) Equity Returns at the Turn of the Month
